frontage.reason: The north arrow points toward the top of the page on both the assessor map (document 0, page 1) and tract sheet 2 (document 1, page 2). Lot 100 sits in the east column of the block between Quakertown Avenue (west) and the street to its east. The assessor map labels that eastern street only 'AVE.' near Lot 100, with 'PENFIELD' printed further south. Tract sheet 2 labels the same street 'PENFIELD AVENUE', and the situs address is on Penfield Ave. So Lot 100's street edge is its east line, bearing N0°01'18"E.

uncertainties: No depth is printed on Lot 100's own bounded row. A '125' appears on the Lot 61/108 row and the Lot 70/99 row, and all side lines bear S89°58'42"E. A 125 ft depth is therefore likely, but it is not printed for Lot 100, so depth is omitted under the same-row rule. For the same reason, no area is derived.
The assessor map does not print the name 'Penfield' adjacent to Lot 100; that street name comes from tract sheet 2 and the situs address.
The tract recording reference (M.B. 515-40-43, Lot 100 shown on page 515-41) is a different identifier from the assessor map 2106-008.
